AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.title: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Managed by the AWS client. Access key ID (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_FILE` is not supported, use `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` instead)

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.title: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Managed by the AWS client. Secret access key (`AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_FILE` is not supported, use `AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE` instead)

AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE.title: AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE
AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE.description: Managed by the AWS client. Shared credentials file.

DNS_ZONE.title: DNS_ZONE
DNS_ZONE.description: Domain name of the DNS zone

LIGHTSAIL_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)
